author: SickProdigy
description: Provider-backed multichain wallet integration with reviewed testnet operation and a default-off Base mainnet release candidate.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores wallet profile identifiers, linked platform identifiers, public wallet addresses, public transaction metadata, notification preferences, emergency-lock status, and optional encrypted authenticator enrollment state. It never stores private keys, recovery phrases, wallet passwords, or one-time authentication codes.
install_msg: CryptoWallet enables reviewed testnet operation. Base mainnet remains default-off and emergency-paused while the release candidate is completed and tested. The companion site handles protected authorization, recovery, export, and account security; ordinary public-address provisioning remains bot-first.
